assumes.assumed: RM.2 drafts the recommended pure bounded compiled chart subset, conditional on admission and LX-7; no user stage is enabled.
assumes.if_other: Built-ins-only removes F05 and retains parameterised stages; a user shader language leaves F05 unavailable until RPI.39 safety, precision and evidence contracts exist. Other rows retain their data and lifecycle.

assumes.assumed: RM.2 drafts a feature handoff before renderer freeze, with required and optional rows explicitly separated.
assumes.if_other: Under no handoff, compare each row with the frozen support list and refuse unsupported content. Any unmet required feature returns to the owner; F23/ONE.41 remains required under either option.

assumes.assumed: Existing D8 remains in force; no placement is chosen. The recommendation allows research views in a research workspace, as RM.3 records.
assumes.if_other: Strict D8 places research content inside Global and Local; free views require an owner D8 change and matching workload evidence. Tool-authoring placement still needs the owner.

assumes.assumed: RM.27 describes required support for the language/product scope actually admitted, without accepting a profile arrangement or product cut.
assumes.if_other: An owner-approved smaller scope requires an explicit changed feature list; a backend cannot silently make an included language feature optional.

assumes.assumed: Display-only ApproxBool/display_if is the integrator working form consumed by RM.5, independently of LQ21.
assumes.if_other: A separate display region replaces that language admission mechanism and checks every exit; publish_view remains the sole display sink and no display-to-exact conversion is added.

assumes.assumed: RPI.45 preserves producer policy and provenance, with no new permission from display or picking; no flow-control form is selected.
assumes.if_other: Static labels, runtime labels or capability separation change producer admission and the boundary checker, not renderer ownership, source identity or mechanical-state separation.

assumes.assumed: RPI.65 consumes chapter 06 claim references; RM.6/RM.13 consume LI.16 canonical output bytes from the data-core profile without defining another profile.
assumes.if_other: Evidence-function choices alter claim presentation inputs, not program-text authority. A different canonical storage profile changes measured canonical lengths and digests; re-pin the profile and vectors without charging compression or transport.

assumes.assumed: RPI.12 and RM.22 use declared dependencies for the current display base; no branch lifetime or transport rule is invented.
assumes.if_other: If branches/pinned jobs are admitted, their existing branch and transport contracts supply the base and dependencies. Revision changes still cancel pending publication or mark installed output stale.

assumes.assumed: RM.14 specifies portable data and host tickets without selecting built-in implementation, engine language or process placement.
assumes.if_other: The selected binding supplies copies or immutable leases and its ABI/transport; it must preserve engine adoption independence, accounting and cancellation. No zero-copy claim follows.

assumes.assumed: RM.28/RM.29 use existing scoped records and the LX-7 card only; this draft performs no experiment or freeze ruling.
assumes.if_other: The owner-selected allowance/order controls future runs and gates; pending evidence stays pending under any order.

assumes.assumed: The engineering working form uses finite fixed plan ceilings and the existing KN7.7 to KN7.10 / LI.16 output budget, with count rules in RM.11 and no measured production values.
assumes.if_other: A separate declared per-run plan allowance needs LP1 versioned units, tariffs and registry reconciliation before KN7:budget.display_plan_limit can activate; no new budget dimension is inferred.

owner_items.why: Only the owner chooses built-ins, the compiled subset or a separately contracted user shader language; all remain open.
Only the owner chooses the feature handoff or fit-to-frozen-renderer alternative and resolves any required-feature conflict.
Research and tool-authoring placement and any change to D8 are owner decisions; no UI/UX work is reopened.
Pick disambiguation is a product choice reserved to the owner when the design line resumes.
The owner sets language scope, profiles and the product cut; support reporting cannot reduce the scope.
Boundary policy and its flow-control form remain with the owner and the existing chapter 07 process.
Any eventual model/geometry identity change for exposed faces requires the owner and the immutable-model process; the supplied unavailable-geometry contract authorizes none.
Renderer selection, experiment allowance and freeze order remain existing owner/gate decisions. This packet supplies no ruling.

These marked open inputs remain open: exact chart checker coverage, precision and singular handling, any user-shader safety contract, and presented-frame implementation/evidence. This draft neither chooses the owner-dependent chart option nor signs off a feature freeze.

S2-01.scope: Renderer-owned clauses only; p7-layers supplies the matching LI.7/LI.25 text.

standalone_refused_scheduled_failed.given: In two independent runs A is pending and the instances ceiling is 4; all other inputs fit. Standalone B submits an existing five-instance payload. Scheduled B is accepted before generating a five-instance payload.
standalone_refused_scheduled_failed.expected: Standalone B is refused(EV3:resource_limit.display_plan_ceiling), field instances, requested 5, ceiling 4; A stays pending. Scheduled B first cancels A as superseded, then fails with that original Error and the same counts on its original command/job/request/lane generation; LI.28 maps error(Error) to failed(Error). A stays cancelled, no second admission occurs and neither five-instance payload installs. Four instances pass this ceiling in either run.

scheduled_invalid_or_unsupported.given: An accepted scheduled invocation produces a malformed descriptor, or in a separate run a valid but unsupported kind; no prior terminal has occurred.
scheduled_invalid_or_unsupported.expected: The original invocation ends failed(EV3:input.display_plan_invalid) or failed(EV3:input.display_unsupported), respectively. No new admission, retrospective refusal, installed fragment or resurrection of superseded work occurs.

S2-03.scope: Renderer-owned precedence and vectors; p7-lang updates EV3 to the same H15.10 form.

stale_pick_before_source_link.given: A generation-7 instance is explicitly consumed after generation 8 replaced its map. Its producing source is a followed by U+1F600 followed by b. First request the unchanged source, then repeat with a source ending in c. Separately use a current pick with that edited source.
stale_pick_before_source_link.expected: Both generation-7 requests return EV3:stale.display_pick before resolution/navigation, including when the source also mismatches. Only the current pick reaches the source-digest check and returns EV3:stale.source_link for the edit. Passive stale replies are dropped.

pinned_source_after_activation.given: A new checked module is activated, but a current occurrence retains its pinned producing source a/U+1F600/b and EV1.10 byte range [5,6); the host requests UTF-16.
pinned_source_after_activation.expected: The old occurrence remains bound and selects b in the producing version at UTF-16 [3,4). Activation alone neither retargets it to c nor makes its source link stale.

S2-05.scope: Renderer lifecycle and contextual forms; p7-reg registers the form and p7-layers owns the sole LI.28 mapping.

renderer_busy_both_sides.given: In one run standalone B arrives while the renderer is unavailable. In a separate run B has running(job), no earlier terminal and loses the device before installation.
renderer_busy_both_sides.expected: Before acceptance B is refused(EV3:busy.renderer_unavailable) with form refusal and its rejection supersedes nothing. After acceptance JobResult.outcome is error(Error(code=EV3:busy.renderer_unavailable, form=stop)); LI.28 yields Receipt.status=failed(Error) for the same command/job, with no installation.

renderer_loss_after_installation.given: B has completed(view_published) and its terminal is still retained when device loss occurs; picks and presentation reports from the old device epoch are in flight.
renderer_loss_after_installation.expected: Drawing becomes unavailable, old pick/report stamps are invalid and latches clear, but B stays completed(view_published). outcome(B.command,B.request) returns that terminal without retrying or rewriting it.

RS3-10.scope: All JI.41 producer rows are crosswalked as draft text. Geometry production, measured limits and backend implementation/evidence remain explicitly open under RM.33 and legacy FR-K05.

crosswalk_coverage.given: Walk all 17 JI.41 rows: static geometry; exact state as floats; swept motion; grip map; blocked-grip certificates; named cut; projection; readback; domain/lattice masks; rim counts; seams; exposed faces; named filters; release/word checks; covers/repair; nu/corrections; H-05 picks.
crosswalk_coverage.expected: Their matrix rows are respectively J01, J02, J03, J04, J04, J04, J05, J06, J07, J07, J08, J10, J09, J11, J09, J12, J13. All carry the defining JI clauses and adapter/lifetime bindings; J10 explicitly returns KN2:input.exposed_geometry_unavailable for absent certified geometry or size profile. No measured limits or backend pass is asserted.

full_straddler_points.given: A complete named-cap straddler set has pieces 7 and 9 with two verified certificate pairs; the cap-map witness is piece 7 only.
full_straddler_points.expected: Retain both pieces and all four points. The cap-map witness cannot replace the set. An over-ceiling payload gets EV3:resource_limit.display_plan_ceiling under RM.12/RM.20 and installs no truncated subset.

uncertain_grip_and_cut.given: The survey contains 599 certified a/b entries and one uncertain entry; the named cap cut carries its exact plane and alpha=121/125.
uncertain_grip_and_cut.expected: Survey coverage remains incomplete/pending, never 600 certified statuses. The cut uses the supplied exact plane; no sticker mesh supplies its predicate.

off_grip_seams.given: A complete all-scope table has one on-grip and two off-grip mismatch entries. A second enumeration stops short of full coverage.
off_grip_seams.expected: Complete total N is 3 with the off-grip entries and distinct domain/cell identities retained. The interrupted enumeration has undefined total N, never a complete count of 1.

named_filters_and_scoped_lists.given: A named piece mask has 177120 bits and the matching input/mask digest; a cover table at cap 0 has all 80 rows and a completed repair list at that input is empty.
named_filters_and_scoped_lists.expected: Use only the caller's named filter and threshold, with no u ordering/filter. Preserve all 80 rows in cap-ID order. Empty repair is cap/input scoped, grants no global negative or automatic selection; a cut-off list supplies no completed negative.

unavailable_geometry.given: An exposed-face request has no certified geometry or no size profile.
unavailable_geometry.expected: Return KN2:input.exposed_geometry_unavailable with no fabricated mesh/sticker ID or supported-feature claim. Geometry production, measured sizes and backend evidence remain outstanding.

release_observations.given: At revision 12 release A is in flight when actual solver release B is accepted; completed checks C then D already exist. The state later becomes revision 13.
release_observations.expected: A is superseded and cannot publish late. C then D stay in tried order; B may append only on completion. The state change clears the revision-12 checks. No step flag supplies execution permission.

nu_and_correction_observations.given: nu is requested off lattice while the correction catalogue contains 36 shipped rows. In a separate lattice check a fixed I_a coordinate is nonzero.
nu_and_correction_observations.expected: Off-lattice nu is undefined(off_lattice), never zero or old values; all 36 catalogue rows stay in fixed ID order without state filtering, lighting, reordering or suggested combinations. The lattice inconsistency is KN2:consistency.fixed_nu_nonzero and cannot be displayed as a valid state.

jumbling_picks.given: A current certificate-point hit targets off-lattice piece 7 and its named grip. Separately the hit's map binding is stale.
jumbling_picks.expected: The current hit resolves witness piece 7 with its grip and source role, no invented slot and no inside/outside certificate or commit token. An explicit stale hit returns EV3:stale.display_pick before resolution, invocation or source navigation; a passive stale hit is dropped.

mixed_revision_arrays.given: A revision-12 pose index is paired with revision-13 pose and lattice arrays.
mixed_revision_arrays.expected: refresh_required(EV3:input.display_bundle_mismatch); no mixed revision is adopted and no mechanical receipt changes.

supplied_correction_set.given: A valid lattice input has all-zero nu and the caller supplies zero multiplicity for every correction row.
supplied_correction_set.expected: The predicted nu vector is all zero under the finite-group sum. All 36 fixed catalogue rows remain in ID order; no multiplicity, combination or word is chosen, and no execution permission is created.

X-CONSUMERS.scope: RPI.50/RPI.55 and their owned display consumers now cite defining clauses rather than the earlier H4/H7/H8 placeholders.

rpi_consumers.given: An accepted publication requires 101 canonical output bytes with 100 left; fixed plan ceilings fit. Resolve the accounting and receipt references in RPI.50 and RPI.55.
rpi_consumers.expected: RPI.50 uses KN7.7 to KN7.10 and LI.16 charging, with LI.28 as the only job-to-receipt mapping. JobResult is cut_off(KN7:budget.output), Receipt.status is cancelled(budget), no 101-byte payload is emitted or installed. RPI.55 cites KN5.21 to KN5.23, LI.7/LI.25 and LI.27 to LI.30; neither clause defines another receipt or budget.

lookup_and_source_owners.given: B installed successfully, its notification was lost, and the same-epoch terminal is retained. Resolve RPI.55's outcome and source-coordinate owners.
lookup_and_source_owners.expected: outcome(B.command,B.request) returns the retained completed(view_published) under KN5.23/LI.30, creating no invocation. RPI.55 cites EV1.10 for coordinates and conversion and LI.16 for output; the display boundary duplicates none of those definitions.

registry_reconciliation: No new error spellings. Reconcile ERR.25 and EV3:resource_limit.display_plan_ceiling with RM.12/RM.20: standalone admission refuses, scheduled final validation fails with the original Error. Keep KN7:budget.display_plan_limit reserved.
LI.28 alone maps KN7:budget.output cut-off to cancelled(budget) for an accepted publication, and physical exhaustion to failed(KN7:resource_limit.host_exhausted).

H15.9 gives EV3:busy.renderer_unavailable primary refusal and contextual stop forms; RM.22/RM.36 consume them. H15.10 checks EV3:stale.display_pick bindings before EV3:stale.source_link. RM.34 uses H15.16's final jumbling code names.
